title: Feature Request: additional information for Insight-Tab
body:
Migrating from Akku-check Combo to Insight, I am missing two simple but useful informations in the pump-tab:

a) show elapsed time between last connection and now
b) show time and amount of last bolus

![rect4535](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/46249367/111036901-f68aa280-8421-11eb-9107-d100954f9e7c.png)

Both should not be a big deal, but helpful if dealing with connection issues.

Thanks for your great work!
